newsitem.title: UK: Leading UK shares end lower but hold 3,900 level.
newsitem.headline: Leading UK shares end lower but hold 3,900 level.

text.p: The London market turned in another disappointing performance on Thursday after falling back to eight week lows as interest rate worries and dollar weakness took a toll on share prices, traders said.

An initial 17 point spike upwards on the back of the Dow's election-inspired surge overnight swiftly evaporated as FTSE futures and gilts led the market lower. The FTSE 100 closed 35.3 points lower at 3,900.4, a near 53 point turnaround on the day.
Shares at one point slid back below the 3,900 mark, the first time since September 11 but a tentative advance in U.S. shares in the afternoon helped steady the market slightly.
